scope: All 408 clips measured; 19 representative families have first/key/last contact boards. This is a targeted visual audit, not approval of every drawing.

findings.action: Tumble now uses uniform simulation-timed centered rotation without the duplicate upright beat. New run-v2 sheets clarify alternating half-strides while retaining the 18-tick period. Inspect the new runs and remaining first-to-last pose flow. Keep the accepted All-Rounder walk unless playback confirms a new defect. Silhouette difference reflects legitimate movement too; low difference can still hide a pause or near-duplicate.

findings.evidence: Airborne preview now uses continuous torso-anchored flight/double-jump/recovery/dodge paths. Grounded actions retain foot registration. Remaining action hooks and full contact approval are still open.
findings.action: Review normal/slow speeds, both facings and distant camera scale; correct torso/foot anchors and contact/release timing before regenerating source art.

findings.title: Palette, face and costume consistency
findings.evidence: Registered first/key/last boards compare the roster at shared world scale with faint idle references. Pixel color averages cannot reliably separate skin, clothing and pose distribution.
findings.action: Compare costume regions against each approved idle reference; target only confirmed drift. Preserve previously accepted Lincoln high kick unless a new side-by-side defect is confirmed.
